title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
松山县，殡仪馆灵堂。背景墙上，挂着一张县长唐志华的黑白遗像。“白夫人，请节哀！”陈青云送走了前来悼念的县领导，又走向县长夫人白婉茹。“陈秘书，这些日子多亏了你，否则我一个女人，真不知道该怎么办……”白婉茹穿着黑色西装，胸口别着菊花。她和县长唐志华是老夫少妻，如今也不过三十多岁，成熟妩媚，保养的极好。可惜一周前，唐志华出了车祸，当场去世，她年纪轻轻就守了活寡！白婉茹悲伤过度，身形摇摇欲坠，下一刻就要栽倒。“夫人！”陈青云连忙张开双臂扶住她，只觉得那黑色西装下是一具成熟丰腴的娇躯，淡淡幽香直往鼻子里钻。若是之前，能与白婉茹如此亲密接触，他恐怕会蠢蠢欲动，但现在前途一片灰暗，根本没那心思。大学毕业后，陈青云考取了松山县的公务员。半年前因为一篇文章，被县长唐志华选中，提拔为副科，担任秘书一职，从此也成了县里的红人。本该是鱼跃龙门，青云直上，没想到唐志华突然撒手人寰！官场上，人走茶凉，而他这个“前任”县长的秘书，自然也会坐冷板凳。“白夫人，我送你回家！”陈青云扶着她的玉臂，走出殡仪馆。半小时后，两人来到了一栋二层小洋房。“怎么回事，家里进贼了？”一进门，白婉茹面色惶恐，忍不住惊呼出声。只见屋内一片狼藉，所有抽屉、柜子、箱子，都被翻了个底朝天。陈青云也眉头紧皱，掏出手机，准备报警。“蹬蹬蹬！”就在这时，二楼传来一阵密集的脚步声。十几个混混走了下来，各个凶神恶煞，纹龙刺虎。带头的，是一个面目狰狞的光头。他望着白婉茹舔了舔舌头，狞笑道：“白夫人，又见面了，乖乖交出那件东西！”“什么东西？我不知道你在说什么……”白婉茹惊慌失措，下意识后退几步，躲进了陈青云的怀中。

那惊人的臀部曲线，让陈青云心头一荡。“光头刘，你好大的胆子，竟敢擅闯县长的家！立刻滚出去，否则让你去牢里蹲几个月！”陈青云怒斥道，声音铿锵有力，正义凛然。“哈哈哈！陈秘书，你当老子是吓大的么？”“若是唐县长还活着，借我几个胆子都不敢来！”“但现在唐县长死了，就凭你一个小跟班，也敢威胁老子？”光头刘气焰嚣张。他就是个泼皮无赖，但背后却是松山县最厉害的地下大佬，乔爷！黑白两道，手眼通天，就算县里的领导都要给乔爷几分面子。“白夫人，唐县长死前，有没有给你什么东西？”“只要你交出来，我们立刻就走人！否则，别怪老子不客气了！”光头刘眼露凶光，恶狠狠威胁道。“我……我真的不知道……”白婉茹拼命摇头，俏脸上满是惊恐之色。“哼，看来不用点手段，你是不会说实话的！”突然，光头刘冲了过来，伸出毛茸茸的大手，猛地一扯她的衣服。“刺啦！”白婉茹的胸口的纽扣，瞬间被绷裂，露出大片雪白的肌肤，甚至还有黑色的蕾丝内衣，若隐若现，格外诱人。一时间，那群混混眼泛淫光，哈喇子都快流出来了。“你……你们要干什么？！”白婉茹双手捂住胸口，又羞又怒，满脸屈辱。“嘿嘿，咱哥几个玩过不少漂亮妞儿，但还没尝过官太太的滋味！”光头刘一脸色眯眯，甚至解开了自己的裤腰带，准备霸王硬上弓。“完了！”白婉茹流下两行清泪，彻底绝望。现在就算报警也来不及了，光头刘既然敢来，那肯定是受到某个大人物的唆使，有万全的把握。今天，她恐怕要被这群混混糟蹋了！“住手！”就在这时，陈青云却挺身而出，抄起一只红酒瓶，猛地砸在桌上。“砰！”
content_en:
Songshan County, funeral parlor.On the background wall, there is a black and white portrait of County Magistrate Tang Zhihua."Mrs. Bai, please express your condolences!" Chen Qingyun sent away the county leaders who came to express their condolences, and then walked towards Bai Wanru, the county magistrate's wife."Secretary Chen, thanks to you these days, otherwise I, a woman, really don't know what to do..." Bai Wanru was wearing a black suit with a chrysanthemum on her chest.She and the county magistrate Tang Zhihua were an old couple. They were only in their thirties now. They were mature, charming and well-maintained.Unfortunately, a week ago, Tang Zhihua was in a car accident and died on the spot. She was left a widow at such a young age!Bai Wanru was overly sad and her figure was shaky, and she was about to fall down in the next moment."Madam!" Chen Qingyun quickly opened his arms to support her. He felt that under the black suit was a mature and plump body, and the faint fragrance penetrated into his nose.If he had such close contact with Bai Wanru before, he would probably be ready to make a move, but now his future is gloomy and he has no intention of doing so.After graduating from college, Chen Qingyun was admitted as a civil servant in Songshan County.Six months ago, because of an article, he was selected by the county magistrate Tang Zhihua and promoted to deputy section and secretary. Since then, he has become a celebrity in the county.It was supposed to be a leap of faith, but unexpectedly Tang Zhihua passed away suddenly!In the officialdom, people take their time off, and he, the "former" secretary of the county magistrate, will naturally sit on the bench."Mrs. Bai, I'll take you home!" Chen Qingyun held her arm and walked out of the funeral parlor.Half an hour later, the two came to a small two-story bungalow."What's going on? There's a thief in the house?" As soon as she entered the door, Bai Wanru looked horrified and couldn't help but exclaimed.The house was in a mess, and all the drawers, cabinets, and boxes had been turned upside down.Chen Qingyun also frowned, took out his mobile phone, and prepared to call the police."Kick, kick, kick!" At this moment, there was a burst of footsteps coming from the second floor.More than a dozen gangsters walked down, each with a fierce look, tattoos of dragons and tigers.The leader was a bald man with a ferocious face.He looked at Bai Wanru and licked his tongue, and said with a sinister smile: "Mrs. Bai, we meet again, hand over that thing obediently!" "What thing? I don't know what you are talking about..." Bai Wanru panicked, subconsciously took a few steps back, and hid in Chen Qingyun's arms.

That amazing hip curve made Chen Qingyun's heart tremble."Bald Liu, you are so brave, you dare to break into the county magistrate's home! Get out immediately, or you will go to jail for several months!" Chen Qingyun angrily shouted, his voice sonorous, powerful and righteous."Hahaha! Secretary Chen, are you scared of me?" "If County Magistrate Tang were still alive, I wouldn't dare to come even if I had the courage to do so!" "But now that Magistrate Tang is dead, how dare you, a little follower, threaten me?" Bald Liu was arrogant.He is just a rogue, but behind him is the most powerful underground boss in Songshan County, Master Qiao!He knows both black and white, and his hands and eyes are all in the sky. Even the leaders in the county have to give Mr. Qiao some face."Mrs. Bai, did County Magistrate Tang give you anything before he died?" "As long as you hand it over, we will leave immediately! Otherwise, don't blame me for being rude!" Bald Liu's eyes showed a fierce look and he threatened fiercely."I...I really don't know..." Bai Wanru shook her head desperately, with a look of horror on her pretty face."Hmph, it seems you won't tell the truth without resorting to some means!" Suddenly, Bald Liu rushed over, stretched out his big furry hand, and yanked her clothes."It's stabbed!" The button on Bai Wanru's chest was torn apart in an instant, revealing a large area of ​​snow-white skin, and even black lace underwear, which was looming and particularly alluring.For a moment, the eyes of the gangsters were filled with lustful light, and their laughter almost leaked out."You...what are you going to do?!" Bai Wanru covered her chest with both hands, feeling ashamed and angry, with a face full of humiliation."Hey, my brothers have played with a lot of beautiful girls, but we have never tasted the taste of an official wife!" Bald Liu Yi's face narrowed, and he even unbuckled his belt, preparing to force his bow."It's over!" Bai Wanru shed two lines of tears, completely desperate.It was too late to call the police now. Since Bald Liu dared to come, he must have been instigated by some big shot, so he was absolutely sure.Today, I'm afraid she will be ruined by these gangsters!"Stop!" At this moment, Chen Qingyun stepped forward, picked up a red wine bottle, and slammed it on the table."Bang!"
